name: Dr. Sharon
source:
Human/Clone

Head doctor at Seon Corp, she is a long time employee and Angel’s boss when Lien isn’t around.

Usually calm and collected, she has her hands full due to the insanity that ensues between the Lei family in the workplace.

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
